title: Well-Made, Works Well, But Not Best Available Corn Stripper Tool
text:
Well-Made, Works Well, But Not Best Available Corn Stripper Tool. If it weren't so fiddly to use, I would really love this RSVP SHUCK DELUXE CORN STRIPPER. The product's clear plastic outer tube is both its best and its worst feature. The best, because the tube catches all of the stripped corn kernels, and is easy to empty. The worst, because the tube must be opened and closed for every single ear of corn; each ear of corn must be carefully positioned inside the tube; and the yellow cap at the bottom of the tube has screw threads that run in the "wrong" direction. (To unscrew something, the mantra is "righty tightey, lefty loosey"--but this tube opens when turned right, and closes when turned left. Probably it's designed this way so it won't unscrew when the corer is twisted.)

The stainless steel "corer" is sharp, and it cuts the kernels off the cob with very little downward pushing effort. However, it misses all the kernels at the narrow end of the ear. The gadget is a little confusing at first, but simple to use once you understand how it works. You cut the kernels off by twisting the scalloped yellow part that's attached to the stainless steel corer; then you use the knobbed yellow part to push the stripped cob out of the corer. It's easiest if you take the knobbed part out before you strip the corn kernels off the cob. All of the corn stripper parts are sturdy, and they are all dishwasher safe.

This RSVP Corn Stripper is slightly more efficient than my [[ASIN:B000V78JGO OXO Good Grips Corn Stripper]], which has to be emptied several times for each ear of corn, and is a bit awkward to take apart and reassemble each time. However, my favorite tool for this job is the [[ASIN:B006GDRD9G Zyliss Corn Stripper]], which strips an entire ear of corn completely with 4 or 5 quick downward strokes (when you hold an ear of corn over a bowl or plate, you don't need either a tube (RSVP) or a container (OXO) to catch the stripped kernels).

Because it's fiddly and not the best available tool for the job, I rate this well-made product at 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).

product_metadata.title: RSVP International Yellow Deluxe Corn Stripper, 10.5" | Quickly Remove Kernels from the Cob | No Splatters or Mess | Dishwasher Safe
features: SIMPLE, SAFER, AND HELPFUL: This ingenious tool makes quick work of removing kernels from the cob. Best of all, when the kernels are stripped, they are contained inside the cylinder; it's also much safer than removing corn kernels with a knife
KEEP THINGS NEAT IN YOUR KITCHEN: Prevents wayward kernels from escaping and corn juice splatters
THE RIGHT SIZE: 2. 75 inches in diameter, 8 inches tall for the main see through compartment, 10. 5 inches tall overall

QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Clear main compartment made with durable BPA-free food-grade #6 polystyrene, top and bottom cover are made from food-grade ABS, and blade is made with an 18/8 stainless steel blade
EASY TO USE AND CLEAN: Turn base CLOCKWISE to remove it for cleaning, dishwasher safe for quick and easy cleanup
description: RSVP strives to offer quality kitchen products and cooking tools at competitive prices. Our RSVP Deluxe Corn Stripper is a perfect example. Our corn stripper makes quick work of removing kernels from the cob and best of all when the kernels are stripped from the cob, they are contained inside the cylinder eliminating wayward kernels and corn juice splatters. Remove corn kernels from fresh, frozen (defrost first) or cooked corn on the cob to prepare nutritious and delicious chowder, soup, or side dishes. Constructed from durable plastic with an 18/8 stainless steel blade. Overall size: 2-3/4-inches in diameter by 10-1/2-inches tall. All parts are dishwasher safe. Patented. When all the right people, and ingredients, kitchen tools, and food come together, we call this The Art of Gathering.
